subject: GlobalFoundries FDX Fusion FD-SOI roadmap for Physical AI edge chips
summary: GlobalFoundries announced an FD-SOI manufacturing roadmap targeting energy-efficient sensing, real-time control, connectivity and edge inference for Physical AI, with production targeted for 2028 in Dresden. A planned process and early evaluation are not shipped silicon, independently benchmarked hardware or confirmed robotics design wins. Counter-evidence to rapid hardware commoditization is currently weak.
